column5: Lady Bian, the wise consort of a great warlord, about thirty, in plain layered Han robes with her hair in a high coiled bun and a single jade hairpin, rolling up a bamboo-slip ledger with both hands, turned three-quarter toward the viewer. Expression: calm, assured, a faint smile.

Lady Yan, wife of the mightiest warrior of the age, in flowing robes under a fur-trimmed cloak, one hand drawing a heavy curtain aside as she looks out, head turned over her shoulder toward the viewer. Expression: watchful, spirited.
Lady Gan, famed for skin as fair as white jade, in soft pale robes, holding a small white jade figurine in her cupped hands near her chest, head tilted slightly. Expression: gentle, serene smile.

Lady Mi, daughter of a wealthy merchant house, in fine embroidered robes with long sleeves, carrying a lacquered casket under one arm and striding forward against the wind, sleeves and sash blowing. Expression: resolute, kind.

Lady Liu, the proud wife of the greatest lord of the north, in heavy formal brocade with tall ornate hairpins, seated upright with one hand on the armrest and her chin raised, looking down at the viewer. Expression: haughty, a cold smile.

Lady Feng, a celebrated beauty of the capital, standing on a high terrace and lifting one long sleeve to shade her eyes as she gazes into the distance, robes streaming in the wind. Expression: bright, elegant.

Lady Wu, the matriarch of the Sun clan, a dignified handsome woman of about fifty with gray-streaked hair in a formal bun, seated straight with one hand raised in command and the other resting on a wooden staff. Expression: stern but warm.
Lady Cai, the shrewd young wife of the lord of Jing province, half hidden behind a hanging bead curtain, one finger at her lips, eyes sidelong toward the viewer. Expression: sly, a knowing smile.
Lady Zou, a widow of striking beauty, seated sideways plucking a pipa lute, her head turned up toward the viewer, long hair ornaments swaying. Expression: alluring, composed.

Ma Yunlu, a young woman cavalry officer of the western frontier, in lamellar armor with a wolf-fur collar, on a rearing horse, thrusting a long lance forward, her long ponytail whipping in the wind. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: fierce, joyful.

Lady Lu, a Daoist priestess with an ageless face, in a dark ritual robe with wide sleeves, raising a paper talisman between two fingers while incense smoke coils around her. Expression: mysterious, a faint smile.

Lady Wu of Chenliu, a noble young widow destined to be an empress, with a tall phoenix hairpin, standing straight with her hands folded in her sleeves and her head raised toward the light. Expression: dignified, hopeful.

Cai Yan (Cai Wenji), poet and musician, kneeling at a guqin zither with her fingers on the strings, hair and scarf blowing in a steppe wind, a line of wild geese in pale wash overhead. Expression: thoughtful, proud, calm.

Zhao E, a young woman avenger of the northwest, in plain commoner's clothes with her sleeves tied back and a red headband, lunging forward with a short saber drawn. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: fierce, determined.
Consort Tang, a young imperial consort, in the middle of a court dance, both long water-sleeves flung out in a wide arc as her body turns. Expression: poised, brave.
Empress Fu Shou, in imperial ceremonial robes and a phoenix crown with hanging pearls, holding a sealed letter in both hands and glancing warily to one side. Expression: resolute, noble.

Lady Du, a renowned beauty, holding up a round bronze mirror in one hand and adjusting a hairpin with the other, looking at the viewer over the edge of the mirror. Expression: bright, confident smile.

Lady Zhen, a peerless beauty likened to a river goddess, stepping lightly above river mist with long ribbons and sleeves trailing in the wind, holding a single lotus flower. Expression: serene, radiant.
Xiaoqiao, the younger of the two famed Qiao sisters, a lively young lady holding a branch of plum blossoms, turning toward the viewer with a laugh, hair ribbons flying. Expression: cheerful, playful.

Daqiao, the elder of the two famed Qiao sisters, graceful and calm, standing beneath a willow and lifting a willow branch aside with one hand, a folded letter in the other. Expression: gentle, warm smile.
Guo Nuwang, a clever lady called a queen among women, seated at a go board, placing a black stone with two fingers while looking up at the viewer. Expression: sharp, confident smile.
Lady Yuan, the gentle daughter of a fallen self-styled emperor, in fine robes, opening a small bamboo cage with raised hands to release a songbird into the air. Expression: gentle, hopeful.

Huang Yueying, a brilliant inventor, sleeves tied back, holding a carpenter's square in one hand and a wooden gear in the other beside a half-built wooden ox machine, hair in a practical bun with a wooden hairpin. Expression: bright, curious grin.

Wang Yi, a noblewoman who defended her besieged city, wearing a soldier's armor over her robes, standing on a rampart with her sword raised to rally the defenders, hair tied back and blowing. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: fierce resolve.
Lady Fan, a widowed beauty of the south, offering a wine cup on a small tray with both hands, head slightly bowed and eyes raised toward the viewer. Expression: graceful, composed smile.
Lady Xu, a clever young widow of the Sun clan, in white mourning robes, one hand hiding a dagger with a red tassel behind her back while the other lifts a curtain. Expression: cold, calculating calm.
Lady Bu Lianshi, the gentle consort of the lord of Wu, beside a lotus pond, bending to cup a lotus bloom in her hand, a long shawl trailing behind her. Expression: tender, warm.
Lady Xiahou, a young noblewoman, carrying a bundle of firewood on her back along a forest path, turning to look back at the viewer. Expression: bright, brave smile.

The mother of the strategist Xu Shu, an upright elderly woman with white hair in a simple bun, rising from her seat and hurling an inkstone, her sleeve flying and ink splashing. Expression: fierce indignation.

Sun Shangxiang, the warrior princess of Wu, in light armor over red robes, drawing a great bow at full draw aimed past the viewer, hair tied high and streaming. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: bold, grinning.

Zhang Chunhua, the iron-willed wife of a great strategist, in a courtyard clutching a stack of bamboo scrolls protectively against her chest and glancing sharply over her shoulder. Expression: stern, shrewd.

Zhang Qiying, daughter of the Celestial Master of Hanzhong, a young Daoist maiden holding a bowl of rice in one hand and a horsehair whisk in the other, two cranes in pale wash behind her. Expression: serene, kind smile.
Xin Xianying, a far-sighted scholar lady, seated with an open scroll on her lap and one finger raised as she explains, an oil lamp beside her. Expression: wise, gentle confidence.

Guan Yinping, daughter of a legendary general, a strong young woman in a green robe and partial armor, swinging a heavy long-handled blade overhead with both hands. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: fearless, cheerful.

Bao Sanniang, a daring swordswoman from a mountain stronghold, leaping forward with a short sword in each hand, her long braid flying, a tiger-skin sash at her waist. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: playful, fierce grin.

Wang Tao, a bandit chief's daughter turned warrior, standing on a rocky ledge about to hurl a spear, a peach blossom in her hair, leather bracers on her arms. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: fierce, proud.

Hua Man, daughter of the king of the southern tribes, with a flower garland in her hair and a tiger-tooth necklace, leaping with a short spear in one hand, beads and feathers flying. A woman's face, no beard. Expression: wild, joyful.
Empress Cao Jie, in imperial robes, hurling the imperial jade seal to the floor with one arm outstretched, sleeves flying and crown pearls swinging. Expression: furious dignity.
Sun Luban, an ambitious princess of Wu, reclining on a low couch and whispering behind a raised sleeve, eyes sidelong toward the viewer. Expression: cunning, amused.
